open_questions: Obtain exact FIGARO and FINEARTS adjudication charter and source-located CEC definitions; never infer identity from sponsor alone
Confirm whether the review's FINEARTS input was intended as recurrent-event rate ratio or a first-event hazard ratio; the primary FINEARTS 0.82 estimate is a recurrent-event rate ratio
Prespecify and separately analyse harmonised first-hospitalisation-only effects if available, with populations and estimands assessed before any pooling
Do not import 842 or 1024 total events as numbers of participants with events or call the pooled mixture an HR
Do not report the unpublished human workbook publicly until contributor permission, attribution and reuse rights are settled

Independently adjudicate separately logged review Table 3 cardiovascular-death interval 0.93 (0.71–0.94) versus primary FINEARTS-HF 0.93 (0.78–1.11); assess both version-of-record presentation and any correction history before correspondence
